behaviors.description: Isolated documented nullable previous_ids rebase variant.
expected: Public gtk-doc permits NULL previous_ids; addition succeeds and replacement installs before old uninstall.

behaviors.description: Unique, remote-qualified, missing and ambiguous operation lookup.
expected: NULL remote finds unique ref, remote qualifier disambiguates duplicate ref, ambiguous and missing matches return NULL with GError.

behaviors.description: Initial zero transfer rate followed by sustained positive rate.
expected: First-second rate samples are zero; paced sustained download exposes nonzero bytes-per-second.

behaviors.description: Cancel required payload after first byte while remainder is gated.
expected: Run returns FALSE and GError after synchronized cancellation; app A and runtime remain.

behaviors.description: Runtime remote priorities, selection and refusal.
expected: Callback identifies exact refs and ordered candidates; index selects remote and -1 fails resolution.

behaviors.description: Flatpakref suggested remote addition decisions and installation.
expected: Callback reason, source ID, name and URL match; remote persistence follows decision; accepted ref installs.

behaviors.description: Resolved B metadata and old A permissions.
expected: Exact B commit, full new and old keyfiles, and NULL unsubsetting at ready.

behaviors.description: Continue and stop after mandatory independent operation failure.
expected: FALSE stops before second operation; TRUE completes independent operation; failed deployment preserved.

behaviors.description: Earlier completed operation survives later payload failure.
expected: Exact completion order and commit remain deployed after later failure stops run.

behaviors.description: Paced transfer progress values and monotonic counters.
expected: Changed status and estimating flag readable; percentage bounded; positive transferred bytes monotonic and start time stable.

behaviors.description: End-of-life notification with exact payload.
expected: Notification identifies retired ref and reason with NULL replacement; update deploys retired commit.

behaviors.description: End-of-life rebase decisions before execution.
expected: FALSE retains old update; TRUE adds rebase-and-uninstall and skips old update; exact signal payload and previous IDs.

behaviors.description: Rebase installation precedes uninstall; absent old ref is ignored.
expected: New app installs before old removal; repeat with absent old ref adds only new install.

behaviors.description: Failed replacement preserves old app.
expected: Denied replacement payload prevents old uninstall and retains exact old commit.

behaviors.description: Transaction option roundtrips and installation association.
expected: Boolean options roundtrip both ways; parent window accepts both protocols; installation path and profile match.

behaviors.description: Both ready decisions with resolved fixture refs.
expected: Refusal fails before execution and preserves empty state; acceptance deploys exact commits.

behaviors.description: Unauthenticated pre-auth inspection and abort decisions.
expected: Resolved refs require no token; refusal precedes ready and execution; acceptance succeeds.

behaviors.description: Disabling dependencies excludes absent runtime from resolved operations.
expected: Only app resolves with flag enabled; default transaction installs both refs.

behaviors.description: Execution order, empty skipped updates, and signal thread.
expected: Non-skipped resolved list matches execution; unchanged update resolves empty; callbacks run synchronously on run thread.

behaviors.description: Per-ref size getters match immutable reference commit metadata and uninstall zeros.
preconditions: fixture.sizes[version][fullref] prepared by reference ostree from xa.installed-size and xa.download-size
expected: Each app/runtime operation size equals its own reference-prepared literal, excluding dependency sizes; uninstall sizes are zero.

behaviors.description: Retained operations, installation, progress status and live cause graph.
expected: Owned results survive transaction destruction; borrowed cause graph is inspected only while transaction lives.

behaviors.description: No-deploy downloads update while preserving deployed commits.
expected: B payload is requested, A remains deployed, and fresh transaction getter accepts FALSE.

behaviors.description: No-pull deploys previously downloaded B without requests.
expected: Flag roundtrips and B deploys entirely offline.

behaviors.description: Explicit A update overrides advertised B.
expected: B deploys, explicit A update deploys A, unchanged runtime remains.

behaviors.description: No-deploy ignores uninstall request.
expected: App and runtime retain exact installed commits.

behaviors.description: Failed and successful operation lifecycle payloads.
expected: Denied download begins then errors with mandatory-error details; retry begins then completes at B.

behaviors.description: Explicit runtime automatic pinning and suppression.
expected: Normal runtime install pins; fresh unpinned runtime with disable-auto-pin stays unpinned.

mappings.rationale: Lookup queued uninstall with NULL remote, then add a reinstall from a different remote and verify each qualifier; NULL remote ambiguity and missing remote/ref must all return NULL with GError. Inspection preserves installed A.
Paced 1 MiB payload produces samples during first second that must have zero rate and subsequent nonzero rate samples, with successful exact B deployment.
HTTP server sends one payload byte, records and publishes in-flight marker, gates remainder. C watcher cancels live run; require failure/GError and exact preserved A/runtime.
Two remotes have unequal priorities; callback payload exact ordered candidates and refs, -1 prevents execution, index zero resolves runtime operation to high-priority remote and deploys commits.
Exact generic suggestion reason/source/name/URL for declined and accepted suggestions; remote enumeration asserts decision persistence; accepted flatpakref deploys exact fixture commits.
Prepared A and B differ in network permission. At ready compare entire old/new metadata keyfiles and exact B commit; C asserts NULL subpaths; abort preserves A.

Probe resolved independent app order, deny unique payload of first operation, then test FALSE stops and TRUE runs remaining independent operation with exact done commit and persisted deployment. Failing operation GError and fatal details checked separately from outer error.
Deny unique payload of second resolved operation; first completes at exact B before failure, and remains publicly queryable at B after run fails.

Paced 1 MiB required payload generates repeated changed signals; C checks readable status and boolean estimating, bounded percentage and stable monotonic start time during positive transfer, monotonic bytes; Python requires payload-sized byte count and successful B deployment.
Reference exporter supplies known EOL metadata; exact emitted ref/reason checked both without replacement and with a non-NULL target, plus exact deployed EOL commits.

Both decisions inspect exact remote/ref/reason/replacement/previous IDs before any new-operation; FALSE updates old ref; TRUE calls public rebase-and-uninstall, installs replacement then uninstalls old ref with skipped original update.
Exact new-install then old-uninstall order and resulting state; repeat after removing new app while old remains absent proves omitted uninstall.
Required replacement payload denial causes new operation failure, no old uninstall execution, old exact commit preserved and replacement absent.
Compare owned installation path and user profile. Option roundtrips alone do not claim fixture-dependent option or authentication contracts.
Both callback decisions, exact resolved refs, absence of execution and installed-state checks.
Exact one-app resolved list excludes missing runtime with flag enabled, compared with default dependency install.
Retained ready list pointer order equals new-operation order, no skipped elements; all-skipped update is empty. Every execution callback checks run thread and active run lifetime.

Feed per-ref immutable xa.installed-size and xa.download-size literals collected by reference ostree at preparation into C assertions. Each app/runtime operation must match its own literal, excluding dependencies; both uninstall sizes must be zero. No target size API supplies expected values.

Owned installation and operation list inspected after releasing transaction; runtime cause identifies app while alive. Actual allocating status result retained across later callbacks and object release, compared to saved bytes and freed.
Getter TRUE, required payload request, exact A/runtime preserved, fresh getter FALSE.
Download B without deployment then no-pull deploy B with zero HTTP requests; getter both settings.
Install B then explicitly update to available A while server continues advertising B, verify exact A/runtime.
Ignored uninstall completes successfully and preserves exact app/runtime commits.
Failed required B download emits exactly new then error with operation identity and GError; retry emits new then done with exact B commit, with C pointer/order checks.
Public pinned-ref enumeration includes normally explicitly installed runtime; remove pin via setup CLI, reinstall with suppression and require empty public pinned list.
